questions.q: In Reading 3B Ch 1 ('Amy and Snowy'), why did the other ducks laugh at Snowy at first?
questions.answer: Because Snowy was big and grey, not yellow like them.
options: Because Snowy was big and grey, not yellow like them.
Because Snowy ate all their food.
questions.explain: 根據 Reading 3B Ch 1 故事，Snowy 起初又大又灰，跟其他黃色小鴨不同，長大後才發現是一隻美麗的白天鵝（swan）。
